decision_question: Does the existing frozen FLOAT model perform adequately on an independently labelled MI48 device-domain dataset?

EXISTING_FLOAT_DEVICE_DOMAIN_ACCEPTABLE.definition: Protocol-valid, group-isolated labelled MI48 evidence meets the separately authorized engineering acceptance gate.
EXISTING_FLOAT_DEVICE_DOMAIN_ACCEPTABLE.next_action: device-domain-aware quantization calibration may be considered under a separate authorization

EXISTING_FLOAT_DEVICE_DOMAIN_INADEQUATE.definition: Protocol-valid, group-isolated labelled MI48 evidence materially fails the separately authorized engineering gate.
EXISTING_FLOAT_DEVICE_DOMAIN_INADEQUATE.next_action: start a separate authorized device-domain retraining phase

INCONCLUSIVE_DEVICE_DOMAIN_EVIDENCE.definition: Evidence is too small, imbalanced, contaminated, semantically ambiguous, or otherwise insufficient.
INCONCLUSIVE_DEVICE_DOMAIN_EVIDENCE.next_action: acquire or annotate more controlled evidence

current_result.reason: No suitable labelled real MI48 device-domain dataset exists yet.
